newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bayer says Jan/Feb profit well above plan.
newsitem.headline: Bayer says Jan/Feb profit well above plan.

text.p: German chemicals group Bayer AG said on Tuesday that its profit in the first two months of 1997 was well above plan and that sales grew eight percent in the period.

"During the first two months we posted a sturdy sales increase of eight percent and the profits clearly exceeded our plans," Bayer chief executive Manfred Schneider told the company's annual news conference.

Earlier, Bayer said it planned to raise its sales to 50 billion marks ($29.6 billion) in 1997 from 48.6 billion in 1996 and said it aimed at least to match profits achieved in 1996 when it made a pre-tax profit of 4.46 billion marks.
